Hill, 118 yards on 7 carries, 2 TDs Receiving: Anthony Evans III, 118 yards on 7 catches, 1 TD Minnesota Passing: Drake Lindsey, 264 yards, 1 TD, 0 INTs, 79.2 completion percentage Rushing: Darius Taylor, 56 yards on 14 carries, 3 TDs Receiving: Javon Tracy, 98 yards on 5 catches, 0 TDs Last game Mississippi State defeated UL Monroe 62-13 on Sept. 5.
